message:
Per #421: apply review notes for instance teardown

This is a follow-up to the teardown/lifecycle review captured in #421 and the earlier LGTM on the runtime ownership cleanup notes.

That discussion already settled the direction for `Instance` destruction: keep teardown aligned with the allocator/instance ownership model and avoid the extra region-retention path in `InstanceHandle::drop`. This PR just applies those agreed review notes in code.

What changes here:
- moves `Instance::alloc` to `ManuallyDrop<Alloc>` so the handle can control exactly when allocator-backed storage is released
- updates `InstanceHandle::drop` to explicitly take and drop the allocation object during teardown
- removes the temporary region keepalive import/path that was only there before the ownership cleanup was applied
- wires construction through `ManuallyDrop::new`

This is intended as a mechanical implementation of the previously approved teardown behavior, not a redesign of drop semantics. The allocator-controlled destruction order was already the agreed approach in the review thread, so this PR is just bringing the code into line with that decision.

I’d suggest reviewing this as a narrow follow-up for conformance with #421 rather than reopening the ownership discussion.
